title: Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 4: Regime Susceptibility and Cross-Scale Mapping
author: Morten Magnusson
type: foundational white paper, regime susceptibility, cross-scale mapping
abstract: Proposes a regime susceptibility function T(S) = S_0(1-S_0)/[S(1-S)] that emerges directly from the S(1-S) structure already present in EFC. T(S) provides a parameter-free cross-scale mapping from SPARC-calibrated galactic amplitude beta_0 ~ 0.16 to a cosmological amplitude giving w_0 ~ -1. The product beta(S)*rho_eff(S) = const ensures self-regulation and GR recovery at S -> 0. Dark matter and dark energy are reinterpreted as convergent and divergent phases of a single entropic continuum.

entropic_continuum.claim: Dark matter and dark energy are phases of a single entropic flow, not substances
entropic_continuum.omega_ratio: Omega_Lambda/Omega_m = f(S(z)/S_max) — monotonically increasing; observed value 2.5 at z=0 is a snapshot, not a constant

effective_energy_density.form: Bernoulli variance — information-theoretic capacity of binary channel

properties.S_to_0: T -> infinity (stiff, small perturbations have large effects)

susceptibility_function.physical_interpretation: Inverse of dynamical capacity; mirrors susceptibility near critical point

self_regulation.proof: Direct substitution: S(1-S) terms cancel identically
self_regulation.consequence: Although T(S) -> infinity as S -> 0 or S -> 1, the physically relevant product beta*rho_eff remains finite and constant
self_regulation.gr_recovery: GR recovery at S -> 0 (Part 1, Theorem 2) is not threatened by T

equation_of_state.no_parameter_recycling: Growth-sector parameter n does not enter w_0

beta_cosm.source: T(S) mapping from S_gal to S_cosm

singularity.description: Maximal order, zero entropy gradient, no energy flow. GR recovered exactly.

altular_limit.description: Maximal entropy, zero gradient, no flow. Expansion asymptotes to de Sitter; all coupling vanishes.

effective_pressure.convergent_flow: Positive effective pressure — structure resists compression
effective_pressure.divergent_flow: Negative effective pressure — system releases rather than pushes
effective_pressure.acceleration: Not driven by energy injection; it is relaxation of a binding constraint as entropy approaches maximum
